description: Brief on brand trust drivers — checks personas are grounded and have specific under_represents
brief_title: Brand trust drivers across urban Indian categories
brief_content: We are designing the 2026 brand trust syndicated study refresh. Objective: identify the dominant brand trust drivers across urban Indian categories, segment consumers by their trust profile, and map the differences in trust drivers across age cohorts (Gen-Z, Millennials, Gen-X). Audience: brand strategy and marketing teams across personal care, packaged foods, and small appliances. Recommend personas that capture meaningful variance in trust profile.
